Retained risks concern Python execution, cloud consent and transport, proxy bypass, browser credentials, unescaped labels, destructive cleanup, and global installation. Static review was capped at 400/1737 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 1337 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Media parameters enter Python source, and frame-rate parsing uses eval.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values through process arguments, validate numeric ranges, and parse frame-rate fractions without eval.

remediation.issue: The TTS endpoint permits HTTP and unchecked redirects despite its hostname allowlist.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and exact approved endpoints; reject redirects or validate each destination before forwarding credentials.

remediation.issue: The TTS configuration loader can import the cloud consent flag.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist TTS configuration keys and keep consent separate from loaded files. Require explicit invocation approval for uploads.

remediation.issue: Narration cleanup recursively deletes a reusable output-directory scratch folder.
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique scratch directory with mkdtemp and delete only the newly created, owned directory.

remediation.issue: Image and video tooling bypass configured proxies.
remediation.suggestion: Honor proxy settings by default. Offer a disclosed opt-in direct-network mode instead of clearing proxy settings globally.

remediation.issue: Deck labels enter innerHTML, and an optional browser demo exposes API credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Render configurable labels with textContent, especially when reusing user-supplied titles. Replace browser key entry with mock responses or a local backend that retains credentials.

remediation.issue: Cloud-review consent omits director-note text sent alongside video.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose every uploaded input before consent and provide context redaction and local-review alternatives.

remediation.issue: The recommended initializer runs an unpinned package before project-level pinning and can install global agent skills.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the initializer itself, review its provenance, and request separate approval before adding or modifying global agent skills.

remediation.issue: The catalog excludes 1,337 repeated or lower-priority static matches.
remediation.suggestion: Review omitted matches before automatic publication. Update the security statement to reflect actual network, consent, and cleanup behavior.

content.user_title: Create HTML Prototypes, Slides, and Animations
content.value_statement: Visual briefs need clear direction, consistent assets, and practical export options. Huashu Design guides three visual drafts, HTML implementation, local verification, and optional presentation or video exports.
actual_capabilities: Guide three visual directions using shared content and brand assets, then wait for user selection before implementation.
Build interactive HTML prototypes with reusable iOS, Android, browser, and desktop frame components.
Create navigable HTML slide decks and export PDF or editable PPTX through supplied conversion scripts.
Render timeline-driven HTML animations to MP4 and derive GIF outputs with local media tools.
Combine narration timing, subtitles, background music, and sound-effect cues into video workflows.
Guide browser checks and structured visual critiques, with optional cloud video review and speech synthesis.
limitations: Designed for visual prototypes and presentations, not production applications or backend systems.
Exports require installed dependencies, such as Playwright, Chromium, FFmpeg, and format-specific libraries. Export fidelity requires manual checking.
Cloud speech and video review require user credentials, external data transfer, and possible usage charges. Asset fetching and dependency installation can also require network access.
Security review identified unsafe input handling, cleanup, and cloud configuration. Fix these issues before running bundled scripts; animation attribution is removable.

Upload confidential notes or enter production API keys into browser demos without reviewing data exposure.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Tool access and available runtime features determine which workflows can run.

faq.question: Does every task require three design directions?
faq.answer: New visual designs normally start with three drafts. Explicit user waivers, approved-direction iterations, and mechanical export tasks are documented exceptions.

faq.question: Can it export editable PowerPoint presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. Supplied scripts support constrained HTML conversion and rendered-layout conversion. Review editability and visual fidelity after export.

faq.question: Do I need API keys?
faq.answer: Local design and export scripts do not require API keys. Optional cloud narration and video review require your credentials and approval.

faq.question: Will every workflow run offline?
faq.answer: No. Asset searches, font downloads, package installation, update checks, and optional cloud tools can use the network.

faq.question: What security precautions are required?
faq.answer: Fix reported script risks and use trusted inputs with isolated output directories. Review uploaded text, videos, and global skill installations before approval.
